title: Between Faith and Evidence · Why read this book?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: What remains when certainty loosens on both sides?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This agnostic investigation examines science, religion, and competing claims to certainty.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Twenty-five historical dossiers explore beliefs associated with influential thinkers.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The discussion separates biographical testimony from scientific and philosophical arguments.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Chapters clarify materialism, atheism, agnosticism, and the boundaries of expert authority.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Educational questions connect intellectual history with evidence and responsibility.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book asks how uncertainty can coexist with meaningful differences between claims.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This invitation is for readers exploring belief, science, uncertainty, and intellectual honesty.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read Between Faith and Evidence to follow the complete argument, examples, and consequences.
